correctness.rationale: From beta v2=A^{-1}v-alpha v, applying A gives beta A v2=v-alpha A v. Q kills v, hence the exact residual identity QAv2=-(alpha/beta)QAv for arbitrary invertible real A with beta>0 and QAv nonzero; symmetry is nowhere needed. Norming the respective candidates yields gamma_3=|alpha|sqrt(m2)/sqrt(1-2alpha m1+alpha² m2), whose positive denominator is beta||A v2||. Therefore gamma_3²-1=(2alpha m1-1)/(1-2alpha m1+alpha² m2) gives exact all-three comparisons, including gamma=0 at alpha=0. Independently checked rational A=diag(-6/5,2,3), v=(1,1,1)/sqrt3: alpha=0,beta²=19/54,det[b,A^-1b,Ab]=28/15,||QAv||²=1568/4275, cond(A)=5/2. The nonzero determinant certifies space nonexhaustion; n=3 is minimal for a possible third independent direction. Starting b=(1,1,2) and (1,2,2) give alpha m1=16/45,47/81; analytic differentiation at the perturbed A_t yields gamma/|t|->95/(108sqrt3). Fresh exact SymPy verifies the witness and both sign regimes. Earlier finite experiments from assigned code do not substitute for the elementary all-matrix algebra.
